question: Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word "Degenerate".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flourish**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Degenerate"** means to decline or deteriorate physically, mentally, or morally. (अध: पतन होना)
 
 
• **Example:** Over time, the abandoned building began to degenerate into ruins.
 

 
• **"Flourish"** is the opposite of "Degenerate" as it means to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way, especially as the result of a favorable environment. (फूलना-फलना)
 
 
• **Example:** The plants began to flourish after being watered and exposed to sunlight.
